lessons.title: Daily Routine

items.example: Je vais au travail à huit heures.
items.exampleMeaning: I go to work at eight o'clock.

items.example: Il travaille dans un bureau.
items.exampleMeaning: He works in an office.

items.example: Nous commençons à neuf heures.
items.exampleMeaning: We start at nine o'clock.

items.example: Je finis mon travail à cinq heures.
items.exampleMeaning: I finish my work at five o'clock.

items.example: Il y a une réunion cet après-midi.
items.exampleMeaning: There is a meeting this afternoon.

items.example: L'heure de déjeuner est à midi.
items.exampleMeaning: Lunch time is at noon.

lessons.tip: Remember to use 'le' for masculine nouns and 'la' for feminine nouns. For example, 'le travail' is masculine and 'la réunion' is feminine.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: What time do you start?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I start at eight o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Where do you work?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I work in an office.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: When do you finish?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I finish at five o'clock.

scenario.partnerRole: A is a colleague asking about your work schedule.
scenario.learnerRole: You are sharing your daily routine.
scenario.brief: Ask your colleague about their work schedule and share yours.
scenario.goal: You should explain your work hours.

lessons.title: Meetings

items.example: Nous allons discuter des projets.
items.exampleMeaning: We are going to discuss the projects.

items.example: Elle va présenter son rapport.
items.exampleMeaning: She is going to present her report.

items.example: As-tu un agenda pour la réunion ?
items.exampleMeaning: Do you have an agenda for the meeting?

items.example: Je veux poser une question.
items.exampleMeaning: I want to ask a question.

items.example: Il faut écouter attentivement.
items.exampleMeaning: You must listen carefully.

items.example: Je prends des notes pendant la réunion.
items.exampleMeaning: I take notes during the meeting.

lessons.tip: Use 'écouter' when you want to say 'to listen'. It's an important verb in conversations.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: What are you going to discuss today?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I am going to discuss the projects.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Do you have an agenda?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oui, j'ai un agenda pour la réunion.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I have an agenda for the meeting.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Are you going to ask a question?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oui, je veux poser une question.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I want to ask a question.

scenario.partnerRole: A is a colleague in a meeting.
scenario.learnerRole: You are discussing the agenda and asking questions.
scenario.brief: Talk about the meeting agenda and share your thoughts.
scenario.goal: You should participate in the discussion.

lessons.title: Daily Tasks

items.example: Je travaille sur un projet important.
items.exampleMeaning: I am working on an important project.

items.example: J'ai une tâche à finir aujourd'hui.
items.exampleMeaning: I have a task to finish today.

items.example: Nous devons travailler en équipe.
items.exampleMeaning: We must work in a team.

items.example: Il est important de respecter les délais.
items.exampleMeaning: It is important to meet deadlines.

items.example: Je vais organiser le travail.
items.exampleMeaning: I will organize the work.

items.example: Nous allons réussir ce projet.
items.exampleMeaning: We will succeed in this project.

lessons.tip: Use 'travailler en équipe' to express the idea of teamwork. It's essential in many jobs.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: What project are you working on?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Je travaille sur un projet important.
dialogue.meaning: I am working on an important project.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Do you have tasks to finish?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oui, j'ai une tâche à finir aujourd'hui.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I have a task to finish today.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Est-ce que nous devons travailler en équipe ?
dialogue.meaning: Do we have to work in a team?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oui, nous devons travailler en équipe.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, we must work in a team.

scenario.partnerRole: A is a colleague asking about your tasks.
scenario.learnerRole: You are explaining your current projects and tasks.
scenario.brief: Discuss your projects and daily tasks with your colleague.
scenario.goal: You should describe your work responsibilities.

lessons.title: Scheduling

items.example: J'ai un rendez-vous à deux heures.
items.exampleMeaning: I have an appointment at two o'clock.

items.example: Quelle est ta disponibilité cette semaine ?
items.exampleMeaning: What is your availability this week?

items.example: Peux-tu confirmer le rendez-vous ?
items.exampleMeaning: Can you confirm the appointment?

items.example: Nous devons reporter la réunion.
items.exampleMeaning: We need to postpone the meeting.

items.example: Je prévois un appel demain.
items.exampleMeaning: I am planning a call tomorrow.

items.example: As-tu un calendrier pour cette année ?
items.exampleMeaning: Do you have a calendar for this year?

lessons.tip: Use 'un rendez-vous' for appointments. It's common in work situations.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Do you have an appointment today?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oui, j'ai un rendez-vous à deux heures.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I have an appointment at two o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Quelle est ta disponibilité cette semaine ?
dialogue.meaning: What is your availability this week?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Je suis disponible mardi et jeudi.
dialogue.meaning: I am available on Tuesday and Thursday.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Can you confirm the appointment?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oui, je peux confirmer le rendez-vous.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I can confirm the appointment.

scenario.partnerRole: A is a colleague discussing schedules.
scenario.learnerRole: You are confirming appointments and discussing availability.
scenario.brief: Talk about your appointments and availability for the week.

scenario.partnerRole: A is a colleague reviewing the chapter topics.
scenario.learnerRole: You are responding to questions about your work routine.
scenario.brief: Discuss your daily routine, meetings, and projects with your colleague.
scenario.goal: You should demonstrate your understanding of the chapter.
